summary: This note describes Serpukhovsky District, an administrative and municipal district (raion) in the south of Moscow Oblast, Russia. It is one of thirty-six raions in the oblast. Its administrative center is the city of Serpukhov, which is not administratively part of the district. The note gives a 2010 Census population of 35,173.
one_line: Serpukhovsky District is one of thirty-six raions in southern Moscow Oblast, Russia, administered from the city of Serpukhov.
key_facts: Serpukhovsky District is an administrative and municipal district (raion) in Moscow Oblast, Russia.
Serpukhovsky District is one of the thirty-six raions in Moscow Oblast.
Serpukhovsky District is located in the south of Moscow Oblast.
The administrative center of Serpukhovsky District is the city of Serpukhov.
The city of Serpukhov is not administratively a part of Serpukhovsky District.
The population of Serpukhovsky District was 35,173 at the 2010 Census.
